description:
Enable the 'Recurring Sales Invoices' module and create a monthly recurring invoice for customer 'Alfreds Futterkiste'.

1. Go to Settings > Customize to enable the 'Recurring Sales Invoices' tab.
2. Navigate to the new tab and create a new recurring invoice.
3. Customer: Alfreds Futterkiste
4. Interval: Monthly (Every 1 Month)
5. Line Item: Description 'Monthly Gourmet Food Box Subscription', Unit Price '150.00'.
6. Save the recurring invoice.
